briefs.title: Task-tracking web app
briefs.prompt: Build a task-tracking web app: users create tasks, mark them done, and filter by status. Local-first, canonical stack.

briefs.title: URL shortener service
briefs.prompt: Build a URL shortener: submit a long URL, get a short code, redirect on lookup, and show a hit counter.

briefs.title: Markdown notes API
briefs.prompt: Build a REST API for markdown notes with create, read, update, delete, and full-text search over titles and bodies.

briefs.title: Personal expense tracker
briefs.prompt: Build an expense tracker: log expenses with category and amount, view monthly totals, and export to CSV.

briefs.title: Bookmark manager
briefs.prompt: Build a bookmark manager: save links with tags, list by tag, and dedupe on URL.

briefs.title: Kanban board
briefs.prompt: Build a Kanban board: columns and cards, drag a card between columns, and a websocket live-update to other viewers.

briefs.title: Recipe box
briefs.prompt: Build a recipe box: store recipes with ingredients and steps, scale servings, and search by ingredient.

briefs.title: Polls & voting API
briefs.prompt: Build a polls API: create a poll with options, cast a vote (one per client), and show live tallies.

briefs.title: Weather report CLI
briefs.prompt: Build a CLI that fetches a weather forecast for a city, caches results for an hour, and prints a formatted report.

briefs.title: Feature-flag service
briefs.prompt: Build a feature-flag service: define flags, target by user cohort, evaluate a flag for a user, and audit changes.
